_comment: One envelope per module group, written by the parent and handed to a screen_group agent. Shape follows the sibling investigation kit's task-envelope.json. The point of the envelope is write_paths: an agent's scope is data the parent controls, not a paragraph the agent has to remember.
instructions: Run the screens in screen_order sequentially. Never start a screen before the previous one reaches its closing gate or is reported BLOCKED.
Write only inside write_paths. A needed path outside them is a BLOCKED report to the parent, not a decision to make.
Registry rows and issue rows are returned in the handoff for the parent to write. Never edit those two files.
Run 3a and 3b concurrently only when backend_contract_frozen is true.
Run only the commands in commands_allowed, and only in check or read mode where the command has such a mode. Never run a formatter or a --fix flag over a whole change list.
On a HIGH gate finding, stop that screen, record it in the handoff, and continue with the next screen. Do not prompt the user.
Return one handoff per screen: artifacts written, gate verdicts, intended registry row, intended issue rows, and blockers.
